$comment: Wire role normalization and lease alias rules (D7). The client speaks play/watch/queue; the server internally uses player/spectator/queue. Validators accept the wire aliases at the boundary and normalize before dispatch. lease/leaseId aliases: responses may carry both, values must be identical, only the canonical field is authoritative.

leaseAliases.rule: both may be returned; values identical; validators retain both (additive F fields are never silently stripped)

roleNormalizationCases.note: server internal role names are never accepted FROM clients

neutralControls.semantics: steer=0, tuck=false, brake=true, jump charge cancelled
